name: Advanced Armour
summary: Models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

name: Advanced Guardian Drone
summary: Ranged attacks that target the bearer suffer -1 to the Wound roll.

name: Advanced Scouting
summary: After this model's ranged attack hits an enemy unit, other friendly Kroot models can re-roll Hit rolls against that unit until the end of the turn.

name: Aerial Disengagement
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of this unit, this unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", provided it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit.

name: Aggressive Deployment
summary: After this model shoots, friendly models that disembarked from it this turn can re-roll Wound rolls against one enemy unit it hit, until the end of the phase.

name: Agile Combatant
summary: This model is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: Air Caste Colossus
summary: Targeting this model with a Stratagem costs three times that Stratagem's normal CP cost.

name: Airborne Agility
summary: At the end of your opponent's turn, if this unit is not engaged, it can be removed from the battlefield and placed into Strategic Reserves.

name: Armour Hunter
summary: Attacks from this model against a Monster or Vehicle gain +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Assassin
summary: Attacks from this model against a Character unit can re-roll the Hit roll.

name: Baggage Harness (Aura)
summary: Friendly Kroot units within 3" of the bearer have their ranged weapons gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: Battlesuit Support System
summary: The bearer's unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back. When it shoots in such a turn, only models equipped with this wargear can make ranged attacks.

name: Blacklight Marker Drones
summary: Twice per battle, while this unit is an Observer unit, friendly attacks against its Spotted unit can re-roll a Wound roll of 1 until the end of the phase.

name: Bounty Hunters
summary: At the start of the battle, nominate one enemy unit: attacks from this unit against it gain the Lethal Hits and Precision abilities.

name: Breach and Clear
summary: Ranged attacks from this unit against a target within range of an objective marker can re-roll the Wound roll.

name: Coldstar Commander
summary: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have a Move characteristic of 12", and ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

name: Command-link Drone (Aura)
summary: Each time a friendly T'au Empire unit within 6" of the bearer is targeted by a Stratagem, roll a die: on a 5+ you gain 1CP.

name: Coordinated Leadership
summary: At the end of your Command phase, roll a die: on a 4+ you gain 1CP.

name: Coordinated Strike
summary: While a Guided unit, this model's attacks against its Spotted unit re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

name: Crack Shot
summary: Ranged attacks from this model that score a Critical Wound gain an Armour Penetration characteristic of -3.

name: Crisis Commander
summary: While attached to a unit, ranged attacks made by models in that unit re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

name: Drone Escort
summary: Once per turn, after an enemy unit shoots a nearby friendly T'au Empire unit, a unit with this ability can shoot back at that enemy unit outside your own turn.

name: Drone Harassment Tactics
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, force one enemy unit within 12" to take a Battle-shock test.

name: Droneport
summary: When this fortification is selected to shoot, its drone weapon attacks every eligible enemy unit rather than a single target.

name: DS8 Support Turret
summary: In your Movement phase, if this unit Remains Stationary, its Fire Warrior Shas'ui model is equipped with the support turret missile system weapon until the start of your next Movement phase.

name: Duality Shield
summary: Once per battle, when this unit is targeted by an attack, models in it can gain a 2+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

name: Eclipse Field Generator
summary: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

name: Enforcer Commander
summary: While attached to a unit, ranged attacks that target that unit have their Armour Penetration worsened by 1.

name: Exemplars of Mont’ka
summary: Ranged attacks from this unit against the closest eligible target gain the Sustained Hits 1 and Ignores Cover abilities.

name: Failure Is Not an Option
summary: While attached to a unit, models in that unit gain the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

name: Fieldcraft
summary: At the end of your Command phase, check whether this unit is within range of an objective marker you control. If it is, you keep control of that objective marker even while you have no models within range of it. This control lasts until your opponent controls that objective marker at the start or end of any turn.

name: Fire and Fade
summary: After this model shoots, if it is not engaged, it can make a Normal move of up to 6", but is then not eligible to declare a charge this turn.

name: Fireknife
summary: Ranged attacks from this unit re-roll a Hit roll of 1, or any Hit roll if the target is at its Starting Strength.

name: Forward Observers
summary: While an Observer unit, this unit lets ranged attacks from its Guided unit against its Spotted unit re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1, until the end of the phase.

name: Grav-inhibitor Drone
summary: Enemy units that charge the bearer's unit suffer -2 to their Charge roll, not cumulative with similar reductions.

name: Ground Strike Fighter
summary: Ranged attacks from this model against a unit that cannot FLY gain +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Heavy Walker
summary: This model can make Normal, Advance or Fall Back moves through models, excluding Titanic, and terrain features up to 4" tall as if they were not there.

name: Hero of the Empire (Aura)
summary: Friendly T'au Empire units within 6" of this model re-roll a Hit roll of 1 on their ranged attacks.

name: High-intensity Markerlights
summary: While an Observer unit, this unit lets attacks from its Guided unit against its Spotted unit re-roll the Hit roll until the end of the phase.

name: Homing Beacon
summary: Once per battle you can use the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP; the unit it brings on must be set up within 3" of the bearer's unit and more than 8" from all enemy units.

name: Hooked
summary: A hit from this weapon against a Monster or Vehicle lets the bearer add 2 to Charge rolls against that unit for the rest of the turn, and stops that unit using Fire Overwatch against the bearer.

name: Hover Drone
summary: The bearer gains the FLY keyword and a Move characteristic of 10".

name: INDEPENDENT POWER
summary: This model and any Ethereal units cannot both be included in the same army.

name: Inspirational Defiance
summary: While attached to a unit, models in that unit gain +1 Objective Control.

name: Jammer Array
summary: Enemy units arriving from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

name: Jet Pack Insertion
summary: At the end of your opponent's Movement phase, units embarked in this transport that all have the Deep Strike ability can disembark from it.

name: Kroot Ambush
summary: After deployment, this unit and one other friendly Kroot unit can be redeployed, including into Strategic Reserves regardless of reserve limits.

name: Kroot Linebreakers
summary: After this unit ends a Charge move, roll one die per engaged model against the charged enemy unit: each 4+ deals D3 mortal wounds, and losses can force a Battle-shock test.

name: Kroot Packmates
summary: Once per turn, after an enemy unit shoots a nearby friendly Kroot Infantry unit, a unit with this ability can shoot back at that enemy unit outside your own turn.

name: Loping Pounce
summary: At the start of your Command phase, if within 6" of friendly Kroot Infantry, this unit is eligible to charge in a turn in which it Advanced, until the end of the turn.

name: Loping Stride
summary: Instead of rolling to Advance, this model's Move characteristic simply increases by 6" until the end of the phase.

name: Markerlight
summary: The bearer has the Markerlight keyword.

name: Martial Warrior
summary: Each time this model fights, choose one of several bonuses (Precision, Devastating Wounds, or an improved Sustained Hits tier) for its signature weapon to have during those attacks.

name: MV15 Gun Drone
summary: The bearer is equipped with one twin pulse blaster.

name: Neocapacitor Shields
summary: At the start of your opponent's Charge phase, target one visible enemy unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) within 12": it must take a Battle-shock test and subtracts 1 from Charge rolls this turn.

name: Nova Burst
summary: Once per battle, before this model makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, it has a Move characteristic of 18".

name: Nova Charge
summary: Once per battle, when this unit is selected to shoot, one of its ranged weapons gains the Devastating Wounds ability until the end of the phase.

name: Nova Shielding
summary: Once per battle, when targeted by a ranged attack, this model can gain -1 to the Wound roll against attacks with higher Strength than its Toughness, until the end of the phase.

name: Oversight Drone
summary: Once per battle, when this unit is selected to shoot, its ranged weapons gain the Ignores Cover ability until the end of the phase.

name: Paradox of Duality
summary: Attacks that target this unit suffer -1 to the Hit roll and -1 to the Wound roll.

name: Pech’ra
summary: Ranged weapons of models in the bearer's unit gain the Ignores Cover ability.

name: Photon Casters
summary: After this unit shoots, an enemy Infantry unit it hit can be stunned until the end of your opponent's next turn, giving it -2 Move and -2 to Advance and Charge rolls.

name: Precise Targeting
summary: Attacks from this unit against a Spotted unit can re-roll the Hit roll.

name: Pulse Accelerator Drone
summary: Pulse carbines equipped by models in the bearer's unit have their Range increased by 6".

name: Pulse Bombs
summary: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, target one visible enemy unit (not Lone Operative) within 24" and roll six D6: for each 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

name: Puretide's Teachings
summary: Once per battle round, you can target this model's unit with a Stratagem. If you do, the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem is reduced by 1CP.

name: Recon Drone
summary: The bearer is equipped with a drone burst cannon and its unit gains the Infiltrators ability.

name: Retro-thrusters
summary: If this unit was eligible to fight this phase, at the end of the Fight phase it can make a Normal move of up to 6" or a Fall Back move.

name: Rites of Feasting
summary: While attached to a unit, models in it gain the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, improving to 5+ for the rest of the battle if that unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase.

name: Ritual Butchery
summary: While attached to a unit, melee weapons of models in that unit gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: Root of Honour
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, remove Battle-shocked status from one friendly Kroot unit within 12" of this model.

name: Shield Generator
summary: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

name: Starscythe
summary: Ranged attacks from this unit, excluding those against Monsters and Vehicles, gain +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Stealth Drones
summary: Twice per battle, an attack allocated to this model can have its Damage characteristic changed to 0.

name: Structural Analyser
summary: While attached to a unit, ranged attacks made by models in that unit gain +1 to the Wound roll.

name: Sunforge
summary: Ranged attacks from this unit against a Monster or Vehicle can re-roll the Wound roll and the Damage roll.

name: Support System
summary: This model's ranged attacks can ignore any modifiers to the Hit roll.

name: Suppression Volley
summary: After this unit shoots, one enemy Infantry unit it hit becomes suppressed until the start of your next turn, giving -1 to its Hit rolls while this unit is on the battlefield.

name: Supreme Loyalty (Aura)
summary: Friendly T'au Empire units within 6" of this unit gain +1 to Battle-shock and Leadership tests.

name: Target Uploaded
summary: Attacks from this unit against their Spotted unit gain +1 Ballistic Skill and the Ignores Cover ability.

name: Targeting Array
summary: Each time this unit is selected to shoot, you can re-roll one Hit roll or you can re-roll one Wound roll when resolving those attacks.

name: Thunderous Pounce
summary: Each time this unit ends a Charge move, until the end of the turn, Knarloc beak and talons equipped by models in this unit have the [LANCE] ability.

name: Tidewall Cover
summary: A model not fully visible to the attacking unit because of this fortification has the Benefit of Cover against that ranged attack.

name: Tidewall Defence Platform
summary: If equipped with this wargear, the fortification's Wounds characteristic becomes 15.

name: Trail Finding
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends any move within 8" of this unit, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", provided it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit.

name: Transport Bay
summary: The bearer gains the Transport keyword with a capacity of 12 Tactical Drone models.

name: Turbo-jets
summary: Instead of rolling to Advance, this unit's Move characteristic simply increases by 6" until the end of the phase.

name: Velocity Tracker
summary: Ranged attacks from this model against a unit that can FLY can re-roll the Hit roll.

name: Volley Fire
summary: While this model is leading a unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit.

name: War Leader
summary: Once per battle round, one unit from your army with this ability can use it when that unit is targeted with a Stratagem. When it does, the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem is reduced by 1CP.

name: Way of the Short Blade
summary: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within 9", add 1 to the Wound roll.

name: Weapon Support System
summary: This model's ranged attacks can ignore any modifiers to the Hit roll.

name: XV02 Pilot Battlesuit
summary: In your Command phase, one friendly Hammerhead Gunship unit within 12" gains the Lethal Hits ability on its ranged weapons until your next Command phase.

name: For the Greater Good
summary: At the start of your Shooting phase pick Observers; each that has not yet shot marks a visible enemy Spotted. Your other units with this ability improve Ballistic Skill by 1 vs Spotted units, plus Ignores Cover from Markerlight Observers.
